title: Timeseries Dataset (simplified input)
description: Simplified input schema for the dataset/timeseries/generic OO-LD transform.

dataset_name.description: Human-readable name for this timeseries dataset (becomes rdfs:label).

dataset_id.description: Optional stable IRI slug. Derived from dataset_name if omitted.

description.description: Optional free-text description of this dataset.

columns.description: Semantic annotations for each measurement column.

name.description: Column header exactly as it appears in the data file.

property_iri.description: Physical property IRI (e.g. QUDT quantitykind or domain-specific IRI).
